investment_theses.thesis: Airline equities (DAL, UAL, AAL) underpriced for demand cliff as margin debt unwinding collides with fuel inflation and consumer credit stress.
supporting_signals: Delta misses earnings for first time in 2 years; cuts 2026 guidance on fuel surge (CNBC)
Record margin debt levels suggest late-cycle leverage peak (CNBC: 'Margin debt has surged to record levels')
CEO 'demand still strong' rhetoric defensive vs. hard miss on guidance
investment_theses.counter_view: Energy prices may stabilize; corporate credit remains accessible; business travel rebounds if geopolitical risk fades (Trump Iran pledge).
investment_theses.expression: Short DAL and UAL equities or buy out-of-the-money puts (3–6 month expiry); hedge with long XLE (energy ETF) for carry.
